$comment: Known high/critical npm advisories tolerated by `npm run audit` (BASE-03, ADR-0021). Every entry needs a reason, the backlog item that removes it and an expiry date: after that date the gate fails again. Moderate/low advisories are reported but never fail the gate.

advisories.reason: Fixed only in zod 4, a major upgrade that touches the sync schemas (track A1). Mitigated meanwhile by the request body limits (BASE-06) and the 1,000-delta cap on /sync/push.
